title: Partitions after each step
prompt: What does this program print in this environment? Adaptive execution is turned off first. Type each printed line on its own line.
hints: `coalesce` can lower the number of partitions but never raise it; `repartition` can do both.
A grouping shuffle makes `spark.sql.shuffle.partitions` partitions, however many the input had. This environment starts with that setting at 4.
With adaptive execution off, nothing merges partitions afterwards. `repartition` with a column but no number uses the same setting.
